title: Seasonal Quest Difficulty Rebalancing
dataSources: Life score (`lifeos:score`), quests / tasks (`quest:task`), habit streaks (`streak:status`), life achievements (`achievement:life`), household leaderboard (`household:leaderboard`), plus every other `index=personal` sourcetype as input.
app: The parody-the-enterprise meta layer — a Personal NOC (house-health wall), Personal SOC (entry / impossible-travel), Personal SRE (SLOs on your own habits), and a gamification layer (XP, achievements, streaks, household leaderboards) — all computed in Splunk over `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=quest:task difficulty_tier=*
| eval season=case(match(strftime(_time,"%m"),"^(12|01|02)$"),"winter",match(strftime(_time,"%m"),"^(03|04|05)$"),"spring",match(strftime(_time,"%m"),"^(06|07|08)$"),"summer",1=1,"autumn")
| stats avg(difficulty_score) as avg_difficulty by season quest_board
| sort season - avg_difficulty
description: Shows whether your quest system tends to assign harder or easier work in different seasons.
value: Difficulty that ignores seasonality often leads to preventable burnout or underreach at predictable times of year.
implementation: Bucket quests into seasons and compare average difficulty score by season and quest board.
visualization: Grouped bar chart of average quest difficulty by season.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces how the difficulty of your goals shifts with the seasons and whether your system should rebalance.
